meta.title: Macro Calculator Migration Roadmap
meta.description: Integrate the standalone Macro-Calculator repository as a new page within Body-Metrics-Tracker. This consolidates body composition tracking with nutrition planning into a unified health dashboard.

integration_decisions.decision: Link calculations to patientId (authenticated user) instead of standalone storage. This enables viewing calculation history per-user and potential integration with body metrics.
Place calculator-specific components in client/src/components/calculator/ subfolder to keep them logically grouped and avoid polluting the main components directory.
Use /calculator as the route path. Protected route like other pages.
Add Calculator link to Sidebar.tsx with appropriate icon (Calculator or Utensils).
Consider optional: Add ability to pre-fill weight from latest measurement. This creates synergy between body tracking and macro calculation.
